entries.surface_description: A selected page with its active-page chip.

entries.surface_description: The pull-to-clear tutorial after three taps.

entries.surface_description: The earned iOS home-screen prompt after a few strokes.

entries.surface_description: The multiplication challenge protecting a sensitive operation.
